title: Toxicity Ahead: Forecasting Conversational Derailment on GitHub
summary: The original Toxicity Ahead pipeline forecasts conversational derailment on GitHub via a two-stage workflow that detects toxicity and then predicts whether an ongoing thread will derail before any toxic comment appears.
This reproduction collapses that pipeline into a single-LLM prompt that takes one thread's pre-toxicity transcript and directly returns a derailment probability.
